description: AgentX replay workload with configurable occupancy-based user capacity assumptions; not measured human DAU.
assumptions: All numeric settings above are editable planning assumptions, not published AgentX human-usage measurements. Recorded delays and fan-out are already included in AgentX; no extra think time is added.

fixedSequenceProxy.description: Optional non-agentic one-outstanding-request proxy. Defaults are hypothetical, not derived from the coding corpus. Disabled to avoid presenting fixed-length tests as measured coding-session capacity.
